title: Lane lint picks a test suite that lists its own folder's files, such as hooks/test_checks_never_raise.py
why: `merge --lane-lint` passed #1447 and #2463 while hooks/test_checks_never_raise.py was red on their own heads, so a lane hands over a red PR that only the batch run catches.
note: Split out of lane-lint-hook-suites ( CST Nov 10, coordinator; that lane measured it falls outside its diff). Cause: the suite finds hook modules with os.listdir, glob and import_module, and the selector follows only named imports and path loads. At #1895's head f25da299c, a change to hooks/local_time.py or hooks/guard_merge.py picks 78 suites, not this one. The suite runs in checks.yml line 236, so it is in lane lint scope. Cost: 69 s alone on main; lint headroom is small (#1844 1100 s, #1895 1070 s, limit 1200 s); #2514's parallel lint is the relief. Suggested rule: a suite that lists its own folder's .py files, read from the syntax tree and not by regex, counts as loading each of them. Red case: a diff that touches only hooks/local_time.py picks the suite. A guard's verdict changes, so a build lane. Coordinator asked for ready; filed blocked, because it extends #1895's selector and waits for #1895 to merge. The coordinator starts the lane then.
